theme: Calendar's open — the trip list is what's loud.
greeting: Good evening, Dan. No meetings on the books today; the day's weight is the Croatia countdown and a morning of errands with the girls in town.

needsAttention.title: Disney tickets are the hard wall
needsAttention.detail: The Orlando/Disney weekend task (Sept 26-27) is due today. Rooms are handled via the villa, but tickets for your six still need buying, plus a check on whether your ticket type needs park reservations.

needsAttention.title: Get the checked bags in writing
needsAttention.detail: The issued Croatia ticket shows zero checked bags. Confirm the allowance on Eurowings Discover's own site with the record locator and buy bags now if needed, before the Sept 8 departure. Two 55L duffels will not pass as carry-on.

needsAttention.title: Book the Sept 19 Cavtat night
needsAttention.detail: The last night after the charter still needs a refundable Cavtat room plus a Komolac transfer. Charter connectivity is poor, so this has to be locked from dry land before you fly out Sept 8.

needsAttention.title: Two St Pete nights, Sept 20-22
needsAttention.detail: You land TPA on Sunday Sept 20 but the girls aren't picked up until Tuesday. The nights of the 20th and 21st near St Pete are still unbooked; the Sept 27-Oct 5 Airbnb is separately pending host confirmation.

schedule.title: Passport appointment, four girls
schedule.detail: Gateway Mall post office; then the stacked phone sitting

flagged.title: Nautilus final payment due
flagged.detail: QuickBooks reminder on invoice 2170 for $6,475, the final sailing-course payment Amy also flagged. The last money item before the trip.

flagged.title: Five nanny applicants on Care.com
flagged.detail: Five people applied to your posted childcare job in the last day.

flagged.title: Tim Soley accepted your LinkedIn invite
flagged.detail: A networking connection went through, worth a note while board outreach is active.

inbox.noise: Otherwise mostly newsletters and account notices: NYT Cooking, the Midcoast Villager, a CMP bill guide, a Carrier system notice, and a Liberty Mutual renewal.

recipe.title: Composed summer salad with french feta
recipe.why: High summer is peak season for ripe tomatoes and tender greens, so a composed salad lets them shine.

tasks.title: Call dermatologist to book wart removal
Buy EU plug adapters + US power strip

acts.line: Errands cluster early: the passport appointment and a run of phone calls to make.
The calendar's clear, which is exactly the room the Croatia bookings need.
Home with the girls in St Pete as the Sept 8 departure tightens the trip list.
